name: 15–20-Minute Weekly Sauna
title: Take one 15-to-20-minute sauna session this week.
subtitle: Heat Exposure
rationale: One weekly session is enough to make heat a repeatable recovery practice rather than an occasional treat.

evidence.summary: Large Finnish cohort data associate regular sauna use with lower cardiovascular and all-cause mortality, with plausible cardiovascular mechanisms.

sources.label: Sauna bathing and cardiovascular mortality cohort

indications: A sauna is practically available but unused.
Recovery practice is limited to passive rest.
Evening tension persists after training or work.
avoidWhen: Pregnancy, cardiovascular instability, recent alcohol, or heat intolerance.
